500001.name: CEC 1
500001.SpecificEffects: In cooperation with allies, launch a <buf ID=900002>[Link Attack]</buf> against the target, dealing <color=#F74848>0.2x</color> DMG, effective up to <color=#F74848>1</color> time per turn.

700012.name: Flanking Firepower
700012.SpecificEffects: When launching a <buf ID=900002>[Link Attack]</buf>, DMG <color=#F74848>+15%</color> and Hit Rate <color=#F74848>+10%</color>.

700009.name: Wide-Range Repair
700009.describe: Restore the HP of all allies within the selected <range type=1>Diamond (2 tiles) area</range>. The repair amount is <color=#F74848>1.0x</color> the Manipulator's Repair AMT. It can repair <color=#F74848>1</color> damaged part.

700015.name: Rotation
700015.SpecificEffects: At the end of the action, if no damage was dealt this turn, restore <color=#F74848>1</color> AP.

500205.name: Special Care
500205.SpecificEffects: When executing an individual repair skill, Repair AMT <color=#F74848>+10%</color>, and additionally repairs <color=#F74848>1</color> damaged part.

500206.name: Balanced Unit
500206.describe: Uses Heavy Machine Gun to attack a target, dealing <color=#F74848>1.4x</color> DMG. After combat, repairs own undamaged parts, restoring HP equal to <color=#F74848>1x</color> Manipulator Repair AMT. Cannot repair destroyed parts.

500207.name: Fix Now
500207.SpecificEffects: If the attack hits the target, grants self <buf ID=5002072>[Repair AMT UP]</buf> after combat, up to <color=#F74848>3</color> stacks, lasting for <color=#F74848>1</color> turn.

500208.name: Slap It!
500208.describe: Dispel all debuffs and restore HP to all parts of an ST. The repair amount is <color=#F74848>2.6x</color> the Manipulator's Repair AMT. Can repair <color=#F74848>1</color> damaged part.

500011.name: CEC 2
500011.SpecificEffects: <buf ID=900002>[Link Attack]</buf>'s effective times per turn <color=#F74848>+1</color>.

500012.name: Part Maintenance 1
500012.SpecificEffects: After performing active repairs, dispel <color=#F74848>1</color> debuff.

500021.name: CEC 3
500021.SpecificEffects: <buf ID=900002>[Link Attack]</buf>'s damage multiplier is increased to <color=#F74848>0.3</color>.

500031.name: Emergency Repair 1
500031.SpecificEffects: At the end of the action, randomly select a single adjacent (<color=#F74848>1</color> tile) ally to perform <buf ID=900018>[Passive Repair]</buf>. The repair amount is <color=#F74848>0.6x</color> the Manipulator's Repair AMT and cannot repair damaged parts.

500033.name: Flexible Repair
500033.SpecificEffects: After performing active repairs, an additional <color=#F74848>2</color> tiles can be moved.

500034.name: Emergency Repair 2
500034.SpecificEffects: <buf ID=900018>[Passive Repair]</buf> selects targets within the adjacent (<color=#F74848>2</color> tiles) area.

500035.name: Emergency Repair 3
500035.SpecificEffects: <buf ID=900018>[Passive Repair]</buf>'s Repair AMT is now <color=#F74848>1x</color> that of the Manipulator.

500036.name: Emergency Repair 4
500036.SpecificEffects: The number of targets that <buf ID=900018>[Passive Repair]</buf> can repair increases by <color=#F74848>1</color>.

500241.name: Old But Not Obsolete 1
500241.SpecificEffects: After performing active repairs, trigger <buf ID=900004>[Re-ATK]</buf>. Repair skills cannot be cast, and move is not allowed before attacking. This is effective for <color=#F74848>1</color> time per turn.

500043.name: Part Maintenance 3
500043.SpecificEffects: Each turn, the AP Cost of the 1st repair skill decreases by <color=#F74848>1</color>, with a minimum cost of <color=#F74848>1</color> AP.

500244.name: Old But Not Obsolete 2
500244.SpecificEffects: When executing an individual repair skill, also repair yourself for an amount equal to <color=#F74848>20%</color> of the Repair AMT.

500245.name: Old But Not Obsolete 3
500245.SpecificEffects: Upon triggering <buf ID=900004>[Re-ATK]</buf>, allows movement of <color=#F74848>2</color> tiles before attacking.

500246.name: Old But Not Obsolete 4
500246.SpecificEffects: After performing active repairs, the weapon's AP Cost <color=#F74848>-1</color>, effective <color=#F74848>1</color> time.
